main_text.p: חֲמָרְתָיִם[?] Acervos tuos, Jud.15.16. Aff. אַתְּחֲמָרֵיהֶם[?] Afinos eorum, Gen.34.28.
יַחְמוּר m. Dama; juxta quosdam, Deuter.14.5. Quidam Bubalum interpretantur. Kimchi in lib. Rad. scribit, esse Animal simile capræ magnæ.

חָמֵשׁ f. Quinque: חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים Quinq; annos, Gen.5.4 v.6. Constr. חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה Quinq; centum i.e. quingentos annos, Gen.11.11. Plural. significat Decies quinque, id est, Quinquaginta: חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ Quinquaginta viros, 1.Reg.18.4. Aff. וַחֲמִשָּׁיו[?] Cum quinquaginta suis, sc. hominibus vel militibus, 2.Reg.1.9. Masc. חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים Quinq; viros, Genes.47.2. Constr. חֲמֻשֶּׁת Jos.10.5. Huic competit idem pluralis, qui ante.
חָמֵשׁ m. Quinta pars, Gen.47.26. אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ Ad quintam partem, sive costam lateris, 2.Sam.2.23.

חֲמִישִׁי masc. Quintus, Genes.1.23. Vel cum Dagesch; בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִשִּׁי Mense quinto, Zach.7.3. Foemin. חֲמִישִּׁית vel חֲמִשִּׁית Quinta, Neh.6.5. Quinta pars, Gen.47.24. Aff. וַאֲחַמִּישִׁתּוֹ Et quintam partem ejus, Levit.5.16. Aff. וְחֻמִּשָּׁתֵיו Et quintas partes ejus, Lev.6.5. Est ex forma singul. & plur. compositum, quo Ab.Esra scribit, significari minus quàm plura, id est, duo sive duas quintas. Subtile id magis, quàm probabile.
חֲמִשִּׁים m. p. Quini, Quino ordine, qui militaris erat; Exod.13.18. Hebræi scribunt, idem esse quod חֲלוּצִים Expediti, Accincti.
חָמַשׁ Verbum in Pihel, Quintavit, sicut dicitur Decimavit: Præter. וְחִמֵּשׁ אֶת אֶרֶץ Et quintabit terram, id est, quintam proventuum accipiet, Gen.41.34. quintam terræ imponit solvendam.
חֻמָּת m. Uter, Lagena: מִן־הַחֻמָּת Ex utre, Gen.21.v.15; Et alia forma, מַיִם וְחֻמַּת Et utrem aquæ, verf.14.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible; the Hebrew at the start of the first line, the word after "Aff." in the first entry, and the Hebrew of the "Aff." form in the entry "חָמֵשׁ" are uncertain and marked [?]. The "Plural" entry is set in small type and may be misread. The Latin "sive costam" in the entry "חָמִשׁ" is uncertain. The running head Hebrew is uncertain. Possible printing error: "Gen.5.4 v.6" and "Gen.11.11" are printed as shown. The "Digitized by Google" mark at the foot is excluded.
